headline: Benchmarks and corrections for transcriptome, single-cell, and RNA-seq analysis methods
label: Transcriptomics Computational Method Evaluation
summary: Recent items address evaluation ground truth, RNA degradation bias, and data leakage in transcriptomic analysis pipelines.
synthesis: The dominant thread is evaluation and bias correction of transcriptomic analysis steps rather than tool packaging. TUSCO uses a curated single-isoform gene set as internal ground truth for long-read transcriptome reconstruction. A systematic study of scRNA-seq batch integration metrics on synthetic scenarios introduces sBEE, a new metric that combines neighborhood composition with other elements. A nine-gene housekeeping set for RNA-seq normalization is selected via CV, stability, and Gini coefficient to limit data leakage in machine learning models. scATS corrects RNA degradation bias in 5' scRNA-seq to quantify alternative transcription start sites per cell. CMDdemux demultiplexes hashtag-labelled single-cell data, and the k-MST and autoencoder-Gaussian mixture study offers unsupervised cell clustering alternatives. Relative to earlier workflow-integration tools, the novelty here lies in algorithmic correction and assessment criteria, while the AMD co-expression study extends MEGENA with new similarity measures.
